name: pace
description: Rate-limit pacing for Claude Code in the terminal: quotas against the clock, paced in dollars an hour across parallel sessions, a per-prompt cost, the prompt cache's timer, warnings before you get gassed out, on pace mode and auto mode for long-running sessions, and $.pace for other mods

placement.title: Pace bar placement
placement.description: above: a band above the prompt. status: a row your status line prints from ~/.claude/pacebar-row.txt

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: 1 hour until a model switch reports otherwise. Set 5m if your account caches for 5 minutes

terminal.title: Terminal app for /pace window
terminal.description: The macOS app /pace window opens in (Terminal, iTerm, Ghostty…)
